statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is in the low band at 18% while Stress stays elevated at 47% into the September quadruple-witching expiry.
recommendation: Observed structure is a stalled upward drift: the 29,966.75 session high has stood for over an hour and the fade off it has held, so Tail remains well below the block threshold. Conditional risk is concentrated in the 13:30Z-15:00Z window, where Industrial Production, the Bowman speech and the US cash open coincide on expiry day, and secondarily at the 20:00Z settlement.
headline: NQ stalls at 29,884.50 as a 29,966.75 session high goes unretaken for an hour, with oil down 2%, VIX near 15.2 and yields retreating into quadruple-witching expiry
body: Nasdaq-100 cash closed Thursday at 29,446.98, up 1.73% (+501.92 points), in a relief rally after Wednesday's unanimous 25bp Federal Reserve hike to 3.75-4.00%, the first US increase in more than three years, with a further hike telegraphed before year-end. The Bank of Japan then raised its policy rate 25bp to 1.25% at a 7-2 vote, a 31-year high, and Governor Ueda framed the decision around inflation, AI-driven demand and currency risk without signalling acceleration. The yen has weakened rather than strengthened since: USD/JPY trades at 157.82, up 1.20% and close to the top of its 155.864-157.910 daily range. A weaker yen after a hike is the opposite of a carry unwind, so the transmission channel that makes a central-bank second leg dangerous for mean-reversion strategies is not active. NQ December futures trade at 29,884.50, about +0.48% against a 29,743.00 previous close. The 29,966.75 session high was set more than an hour ago and has not been retaken; price has drifted roughly 82 points below it and now sits around 74% of the way up the 29,648.00-29,966.75 overnight band. A high that stands while price eases is a failed extension, which is the opposite of the repeated-extension-after-failed-retracement pattern that defines a pathological path. ES trades +0.26% against NQ at +0.48%, so leadership remains tech-specific rather than a broad index thrust. Cross-assets continue to de-escalate: WTI has fallen to $95.29, down 2.00% in a 94.83-96.84 range and declining for a fifth consecutive session as Saudi Arabia routes crude around the damaged East-West pipeline through ship-to-ship transfers outside Hormuz, with reporting noting that fresh Saudi-Houthi strikes have not reversed the decline; VIX trades at 15.22, down 1.42% in a 14.99-15.29 range; and the 10-year Treasury yield sits near 4.947% after retreating from about 5.01%, with the 2-year at 4.74% on the latest H.15 release. Falling oil, a softening VIX and a retreating 10-year remove the amplifiers that would otherwise support a persistent no-retracement path, which is why elevated Stress coexists with a low-band Tail. The shared Finviz context file was last collected at 06:43Z with partial status and missing futures and calendar sections, so it is stale under the 90-minute rule and has not been used as evidence in this assessment. The day's structural feature is the September quadruple-witching expiration, which settles at the 20:00Z cash close, with August Industrial Production at 13:15Z, a Fed Bowman speech at 13:30Z and the CB Leading Index at 14:00Z framing the US open. Conditional risk is therefore concentrated in the 13:30Z-15:00Z window, where opening continuation on an already-extended index is either confirmed or rejected. CME equity futures halt for the weekend from 21:00Z, after which no live price path exists and Tail falls to the weekend floor for the remainder of the horizon.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Tail ranged 17-26% and Stress decayed from 63% to the low 40s before ticking back toward 50% around the BOJ decision. The single orange hour was 13:00Z Thursday at the US cash open, where trend-up structure was most pronounced; Tail fell back through the afternoon as retracements reappeared. From 22:00Z the overnight hours settled into a normal, range-bound mode with Tail 17-18% and Confidence near 87%, and that regime held through the BOJ statement and the Ueda press conference without a disorderly repricing. The 07:00Z and 08:00Z hours returned to a trend-up read as NQ pressed the top of its band, and the last hour has since stalled below that high.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours carry one narrow conditional-risk peak. Tail holds at 18% through the European morning, then moves into the watch band at 11:00Z as US pre-market positioning builds for quadruple-witching expiry. It reaches 23% at 13:00Z, where Industrial Production, the Bowman speech and the cash open coincide, and the single hour mapped to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES is 14:00Z at Tail 25%, covering the window in which opening continuation is confirmed or rejected. Tail then eases through the US afternoon, with a secondary Stress peak at the 20:00Z quadruple-witching settlement. From 21:00Z the CME weekend halt removes any live price path, so Tail falls to 12-15% and Confidence eases into the solid band for the remaining slots.
